title: Nightly throughput validation - surge credit request
text:
Nightly throughput validation - surge credit request

["From: Priya Reddy <ops@datascale.ai>\\nTo: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>\\nCc: Alex Chen <alex@edgeapps.com>\\nDate: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 22:14:00 -0700\\nSubject: Nightly throughput validation - surge credit request\\n\\nHi Vivek,\\n\\nThanks again for the intro — we kicked off the first smoke yesterday. For our planned nightly throughput validation (24h soak, heavy tail traffic between 2am-6am PT) the engineering team is asking for a short, isolated credit uplift so the POC can run realistic concurrency profiles without hitting quota limits.\\n\\nSummary:\\n- Account: DataScale (POC + integration)\\n- Window requested: 2027-07-20 02:00 PDT -> 2027-07-21 02:00 PDT (24 hours)\\n- Requested uplift: 150k tokens equivalent (ephemeral, one-off)\\n- Purpose: validate p95 latency under sustained 2k rps simulated load, check KV-cache behavior and autoscaling boundaries\\n- Success signals: p95 <= 220ms, no OOMs, no >5% 5xx errors over window\\n\\nI've attached the run plan (poc-run-plan.pdf) and a short load profile. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provision a temporary voucher/allowance or if we should shift to a short Dedicated warmup? Also flagging that Alex (cc'd) is the technical lead for the run.\\n\\nAppreciate quick confirmation — our target for decision is EOD Tuesday so we can finalize test harness.\\n\\nBest,\\nPriya Reddy\\nEngineering Ops, DataScale\\nops@datascale.ai\\n\\nAttachment: poc-run-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page)", 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>\\nTo: Priya Reddy <ops@datascale.ai>\\nCc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference>\\nDate: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 07:03:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Nightly throughput validation - surge credit request\\n\\nHi Priya — thanks for the deck and clear success criteria. Quick answers up front: we can do a time-limited ephemeral allowance (voucher) tied to the account for the 24h window. I need a short internal approval and confirmation on the exact token target; 150k tokens aligns with similar runs but please confirm if that number is \\"total tokens\\" or \\"per-day\\".\\n\\nOperational notes:\\n- We\'ll attach an ephemeral voucher to your account that will only be valid for the 24h window you specified.\\n- Rate limits and autoscale will remain the same; this only increases the consumption allowance. If you anticipate simultaneous competing tests we recommend pinning a dedicated pool — we can advise if so.\\n\\nNext steps from our side:\\n1) I need a signed allocation request (I attached a one-page form) — return by EOD to speed approval.\\n2) I\'ll route for provisional approval from finance/product for this POC uplift.\\n3) If approved, we will send a DocuSign acknowledgement and the voucher code ~24 hours before the test window.\\n\\nI\'ll mark this for expedited review. Priyom / Hannah — can one of you OK a 150k token, 24h ephemeral uplift for DataScale DS-POC-7721? Notes on risk: minimal; chargebacks are standard.\\n\\nThanks,\\nVivek Kulkarni\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\nvivek@redwood.inference\\nPhone: +1 (415) 555-0189\\n\\nAttachment: allocation_request_form.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page)', "From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>\\nTo: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>\\nCc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference>\\nDate: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Nightly throughput validation - surge credit request\\n\\nVivek — approved provisionally.\\n\\nI reviewed the run plan and the numbers look reasonable for a one-off verification. Approving 150,000 tokens for the 24h window with the following conditions:\\n- Voucher expires exactly at 2027-07-21T02:00:00-07:00 (UTC-7) and cannot be reused\\n- Test must be run from the DataScale account only; no cross-account routing\\n- Engineering must provide a short post-run noise/latency report in <= 72 hours (simple CSV + 1-paragraph summary)\\n\\nI'll add a quick stamp in the approval artifact and forward to finance for accounting tagging. Tagging finance owner (internal) to reserve the promo bucket.\\n\\n— Priyom\\nPriyom Das\\nSales Operations, Redwood Inference\\npriyom@redwood.inference\\n\\nAttachment: approval-stamp.png (image/png, signature stamp)", 'From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>\\nTo: Priya Reddy <ops@datascale.ai>\\nCc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference>\\nDate: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Nightly throughput validation - surge credit request\\n\\nPriya — good news: approval granted. We attached a one-time ephemeral voucher worth 150,000 tokens to DataScale (DS-POC-7721). Details below and next steps.\\n\\nVoucher details:\\n- Code: RDW-PROC-7721-EPH\\n- Amount: 150,000 token-equivalent\\n- Valid: 2027-07-20T02:00:00-07:00 -> 2027-07-21T02:00:00-07:00\\n- Scope: Account-level, non-transferable, single use\\n\\nOperational notes and checklist:\\n- Please confirm you have the latest SDK pinned (redwood-sdk v1.6.2) — caching behavior improved in this patch.\\n- Run from the DataScale integration key provided in your onboarding (do not switch keys during the window).\\n- If you expect to exceed 2k rps sustained across peers, please pause and notify us — we will coordinate a quick escalation path.\\n\\nAdmin: you will receive a DocuSign acknowledgement for the ephemeral grant (link below). Return signed copy prior to the start of the window; we will not activate the voucher until the signed acknowledgement is returned.\\n\\nDocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/txn/abc123\\nHubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/DS-7721\\nDrive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-plan\\n\\nPlease reply to confirm receipt and to attach the signed allocation_request_form.pdf. Once we have the signed form, I will push the voucher ~24 hours before your start time.\\n\\nLooking forward to the results — please send the post-run summary as requested so we can close the promo tag cleanly.\\n\\nBest,\\nVivek\\nAccount Executive, Redwood Inference\\nvivek@redwood.inference\\nPhone: +1 (415) 555-0189']
